name: escalation-predictor
description: Scores your open support-desk tickets for the risk that they escalate (priority, age, customer tier, unanswered customer messages, frustration, escalation language like "cancel" or "manager", reopens), ranks them with a transparent points breakdown, and matches each at-risk ticket to known open bugs in your tracker so the support agent can send a status update. The score is computed in code, never by the model. On request it drafts a copyable status reply that never promises a fix date. Read-only: it never sends a reply or changes a ticket. Works on pasted tickets when no support desk is connected. Not a ticket triager, not a reply sender and not a bug-fix announcer.

skills.name: Predict which support tickets will escalate
skills.description: Ranks open support tickets by escalation risk with the reason for every point, links the risky ones to known open bugs, and drafts a copyable status reply on request.
